messages.author: Jenny 148
messages.body:
Hi,
I have a set of wild type and single point mutated protein systems. We
believe that the mutation at residue 201 alters the water order and somehow
affects the hydration. We wanted to do the gist analysis one at the site of
mutation and one at the catalytic residue. Could someone help how to set
the grid for this kind of a scenario? Is there some sample script to use?
Our protein is 300 aa long. And the sites we want to focus is around
residue 201 and residue 53.
Any suggestions would be appreciated.
Regards,
Jenny
